'''Medcha Wanto''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] who lived on [[Orto Plutonia/Legends|Orto Plutonia]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and the scribe to his chieftain, [[Thi-Sen/Legends|Thi-Sen]].

==Biography==
[[File:Medcha_Wanto.png|thumb|left|180px|Medcha Wanto with his chieftain, Thi-Sen]]

When the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] arrived at the Talz village to investigate the attack on the [[Glid Station/Legends|Republic outpost]], they were greeted by Thi-Sen, who invited them to his hut, where Medcha Wanto helped him communicate with Jedi by scratching images on the pieces of skin of an animal. Using these primitive form of communications, the Jedi organized a meeting for [[Thi-Sen/Legends|Thi-Sen]] and [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]] representatives. Despite the short but violent [[Battle of Orto Plutonia/Legends|conflict]], that broke afterwards, the Jedi were able to settle peace between Talz and [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantorans]] with the help of the young [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Riyo Chuchi/Legends|Riyo Chuchi]], allowing [[Thi-Sen/Legends|Thi-Sen]] and his clan to live in peace.<ref name="TCWTrespass" />
